bio-portada: #2e7d4f green with touches of teal and ochre

A harmonious still-life collage of biology at several scales: a fern frond and a sprig of pea plant with pods on the right, a glass Petri dish, a translucent eukaryotic animal cell with nucleus and mitochondria, and a short right-handed DNA double helix drawn correctly as B-DNA with major and minor grooves.
bio-tema1: Biomolecules: a large clear water droplet with a ribbon diagram of a folded globular protein (alpha helices drawn as coiled ribbons and beta sheets as flat arrows) floating beside it, and starch granules and lipid droplets as soft shapes in the background.
bio-tema2: A three-dimensional cutaway of a eukaryotic animal cell: a large nucleus with nuclear pores and a nucleolus, rough endoplasmic reticulum studded with ribosomes continuous with the nuclear envelope, Golgi stacks, several mitochondria with cristae, lysosomes and a phospholipid bilayer membrane at the cut edge. No cell wall and no chloroplasts.
bio-tema3: Energy in living things: sunlight falling on leaves, with a magnified oval chloroplast showing stacks of thylakoids (grana) on one side and a magnified mitochondrion with folded inner membrane cristae on the other, linked by a soft glowing flow.
bio-tema4: Classical genetics: garden pea plants (Pisum sativum) climbing with tendrils, some with purple flowers and some with white flowers, open pea pods showing smooth round green and yellow seeds, and a few wrinkled seeds, arranged like a naturalist's study plate.
bio-tema5: Molecular genetics: a long right-handed B-DNA double helix (two antiparallel sugar-phosphate backbones, flat base pairs as rungs, clearly visible major and minor grooves, turning clockwise as it goes away from the viewer) partly unwinding at one end where a single messenger RNA strand emerges.
bio-tema6: Evolution: several Galapagos finches perched on branches showing clearly different beak shapes (thick seed-cracking beak, slender insect-eating beak, medium beak), with ammonite and trilobite fossils embedded in layered sedimentary rock at the bottom.
bio-tema7: Microbiology: a glass Petri dish on agar with round bacterial colonies of different sizes and colours, and a magnified inset of rod-shaped bacteria with flagella, plus a few T4-type bacteriophages (icosahedral head, tail and tail fibres) attached to one bacterium.
bio-tema8: Immunology: a macrophage extending pseudopods to engulf rod-shaped bacteria, with Y-shaped antibodies (four chains, two identical arms) binding to the bacteria and a few lymphocytes nearby, rendered as a soft microscopic scene.
bio-tema9: #5f6670 slate grey with a teal accent

Experimental design in a biology lab: a tidy lab bench with a rack of unlabelled test tubes in a graded colour series, a micropipette, a light microscope and an open notebook with a simple line chart sketch (no writing).
